data.name: Chronos Phantasia
data.detailed_description:
Combat System

You can pick up and use anything around you as a weapon. If enemies hit you, they knock your weapon away. You can fight with your fists if you have no weapon. You can sneak past enemies or fight them.

Momentum Bar. The longer you wield a weapon, the more the momentum and connection with the weapon increases more damages you do.

data.short_description: Chronos Phantasia revolutionizes action RPG combat by letting players transform ANY object into a powerful weapon through our unique Momentum system. As players master timing and build spiritual connections with their weapons, ethereal souls manifest as combat companions.
